text_block_list.text: On the way back from looking at sports equipment with Eishin Flash—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? What a nostalgic scent.
This sweet, savory aroma of fried sugar is...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that shop?
It seems to be a newly opened German pastry shop."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Those are Schneebälle...! Freshly fried, they look absolutely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a famous deep-fried pastry from Germany.
It's sweet and crispy, with all kinds of toppings...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, they have 'kinako flavor.'
A topping unique to Japan."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Compared to chocolate or powdered sugar, it's less sweet,
allowing you to enjoy its rich, aromatic flavor.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... *ahem*. However, it is almost time for dinner.
Let us save it for another occasion.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Unscheduled snacking
will lead to excess calories."
choice_data_list: Shall we split one in half?
Want to split one in half?
Let's eat plenty to make up for all that walking!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Unscheduled snacking
will lead to excess calories."
choice_data_list: Shall we split one in half?
Want to split one in half?
Let's eat plenty to make up for all that walking!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Splitting it in half...!
That's a wonderful idea.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'll go buy a kinako-flavored one right away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The kinako was wonderfully aromatic, just as I expected.
It was truly delicious...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was fluffier and lighter in texture than the Schneeballen we serve at my family's shop.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The dough is also less sweet than the German version,
and it seems they use a different kind of frying oil as well."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad we could each eat half.
Thanks to that, I could enjoy it without worrying about the calories.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A lot...?
That many would be a few too many calories...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Still, having walked more than usual today,
perhaps I have burned more energy...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "It seems we'll need to replenish the energy we've lost..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I think I will follow Trainer-san's advice after all
and make sure to properly replenish my energy.

Eishin Flash hurried off to the shop
and enjoyed Schneeballen until she was full.
